name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-decimal-array-modification-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: value:cloneWithType; value:fromJsonWithType; value:toString and value:toBalString.
reason: The expected panic when modifying the decimal array depends on d.cloneReadOnly() producing a frozen array. cloneReadOnly is absent from both the supported lang.value functions and the langlib method-call allowlist, so this essential behavior is outside the subset.
unsupported_constructs: lang.value cloneReadOnly invoked as d.cloneReadOnly(), including the frozen clone behavior needed for the subsequent mutation panic
test_design_notes: The @panic assertion concerns modification of the clone at index 3; ordinary array assignment alone does not establish support for the freezing operation.
